title: Hand-Writable Peptide Vial Labels: Test the Marker Before You Order
seoTitle: Writable Peptide Vial Labels: Marker Test | RP Labels
description: Plan a writable lot field on custom peptide vial labels, then test the actual marker, finish, drying time and handling before approving the roll.
alt: AI-generated RP Research glass sample vials with printed lot fields, a label roll and a gloved hand writing with a marker
caption: AI-generated packaging concept, not an RP factory test or real lot record. Handwritten fields and dates are illustrative; approve your own artwork and marker on the actual stock.

sources: Avery: writing on printed roll labels

title: Multi-SKU Peptide Vial Labels: What a Visual Inspection Must Catch
seoTitle: Multi-SKU Peptide Vial Label Inspection | RP Labels
description: Define visual and machine-vision checks for mixed peptide vial label SKUs: identity, color, lot fields, placement and rejects on the filled sample pack.
alt: AI-generated color-coded RP Research sample vials on an inspection bench beside an artwork comparison sheet
caption: AI-generated inspection scenario, not an RP production line, validated vision setup or proof of inspection performance. Sample names are fictional.

title: PET Supplement Bottle Labels: Ask About the Whole Recycling Construction
seoTitle: PET Supplement Bottle Label Recycling | RP Labels

title: Front and Back Supplement Bottle Labels: Keep the Gap and Barcode in Place
seoTitle: Supplement Bottle Front/Back Label Placement | RP

alt: AI-generated RP Wellness amber supplement bottles shown front and back beside label layout proof and bottle applicator
caption: AI-generated layout example, not approved supplement copy, a valid barcode, a fixed spacing requirement or a measured RP applicator result.

title: Hologram QR Labels: Who Owns the Link After the Roll Is Printed?
seoTitle: Hologram QR Label Link Ownership | RP Labels
description: Decide who controls the QR domain, redirect and destination before ordering a holographic security label that may remain on packs for years.
alt: AI-generated RP Secure hologram carton seal with a decorative QR-like panel, label roll and generic destination preview on a phone
caption: AI-generated concept image. QR-like marks and routing screens are decorative, not functional identifiers or proof of authentication, link operation or security performance.
intro: A QR code can still scan beautifully after the page behind it disappears. Print approval has to include a link ownership decision.
sources: GS1: redirection from scan to content
GS1: digital signatures and copied QR codes
